{
  "name": "sanity-ui-monorepo",
  "version": "0.0.0",
  "private": true,
  "license": "MIT",
  "author": "Sanity.io <hello@sanity.io>",
  "scripts": {
    "build": "pnpm --filter @sanity/ui build && pnpm --filter figma-plugin-sanity-ui build",
    "changeset": "changeset",
    "clean": "pnpm --recursive clean",
    "dev": "pnpm --filter sanity-ui-storybook dev",
    "dev:docs": "pnpm --filter sanity-ui-docs dev",
    "dev:studio": "pnpm --filter sanity-ui-studio dev",
    "format": "oxfmt . --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern",
    "knip": "knip --treat-config-hints-as-errors",
    "lint": "pnpm run oxlint",
    "lint:fix": "pnpm lint --fix --fix-suggestions",
    "oxlint": "oxlint --disable-nested-config",
    "react-devtools-mcp:chrome": "pnpm --filter sanity-ui-storybook react-devtools-mcp:chrome",
    "react-devtools-mcp:storybook": "ENABLE_REACT_DEVTOOLS_MCP=true pnpm dev",
    "release": "changeset publish",
    "storybook:build": "pnpm --filter sanity-ui-storybook build",
    "test": "pnpm --filter @sanity/ui test",
    "test:browser": "pnpm --filter sanity-ui-storybook test",
    "test:coverage": "pnpm --filter @sanity/ui exec vitest run --coverage",
    "watch": "pnpm --filter @sanity/ui watch"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@changesets/changelog-github": "^1.0.1",
    "@changesets/cli": "^3.0.3",
    "@types/node": "catalog:",
    "eslint-plugin-storybook": "^10.6.2",
    "knip": "^6.42.0",
    "oxfmt": "^0.74.0",
    "oxlint": "^1.89.0",
    "oxlint-tsgolint": "^7.0.2004",
    "typescript": "catalog:"
  },
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=22.13"
  },
  "packageManager": "pnpm@12.14.0"
}
